answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks via optical physical unclonable functions checked at docking hubs. Each node bonds its signing chip to an epoxy token of jade and walnut grit that scatters laser light into a unique speckle field. Hubs keep a private challenge-response atlas of beam angles and verify unused angles with signed nonces. Because cloning micro-scatterers is infeasible, attackers incur hardware fabrication costs per identity, though thermal drift or scratches degrade speckles.
